blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo. In this lesson, you learn the everyday English you need when you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting.

Today you learn five useful words: internet, Wi-Fi, connection, router, and speed. You practise them in short, natural sentences. Good IT habits protect the whole company.

Go slowly — one step at a time. Small IT habits today save big problems tomorrow. You can do it!

items.q: Which offices does IT support?
items.why: "IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo."

items.q: How many new words do you learn today?
items.why: "Today you learn five useful words."

items.q: When do you need this English?
options: When you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting
items.why: "...when you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting."

items.q: The text suggests that good IT habits are…
items.why: Inferência: "Good IT habits protect the whole company" e "Small IT habits today save big problems tomorrow."

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that you should…
options: take it slowly, one step at a time
items.why: Inferência: "Go slowly — one step at a time. You can do it!"

blocks.instruction: Ouça James explicar onde o Wi-Fi funciona e ajudar um usuário a se conectar. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! I'm James from IT. Let me help you connect to the internet.

The Wi-Fi works in this room and in the meeting room next door. It does not work in the garage. So please sit at your desk or in the meeting room.

First, look at the network on your screen. Click on "Czarnikow". Then type the password. The password is on the help desk board, on the wall by the door.

Now check your connection. Is it green? Good. The speed is fine today. You can join your online meeting now.

One more thing. We restart the router every evening, just in case. So in the morning the internet is fast and ready. If something looks strange, call IT support. Our team is small, but very responsive. Have a good day!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where does the Wi-Fi work?
options: In this room and in the meeting room
items.why: "The Wi-Fi works in this room and in the meeting room next door."

items.q: Where is the password?
items.why: "The password is on the help desk board, on the wall by the door."

items.q: When does the team restart the router?
items.why: "We restart the router every evening, just in case."

items.q: Why does James restart the router every evening?
options: So the internet is fast and ready in the morning
items.why: Inferência: "...just in case. So in the morning the internet is fast and ready."

items.q: What does James think about the IT team?
options: It is small but very responsive
items.why: Inferência: "Our team is small, but very responsive" — James fala do time com orgulho.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The internet is working well today." The internet is…
options: the global network that connects computers
items.why: Internet = a rede mundial que conecta os computadores.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "There's a new ___ on the help desk board. Just type the password to connect."
items.why: Wi-Fi = a rede sem fio à qual você se conecta com uma senha.

items.q: "The connection is ready for you to check." A connection is…
options: a link between your device and the network
items.why: Connection = conexão: o link entre seu aparelho e a rede.

items.q: "We restart the router every evening." A router is…
options: a device that sends the Wi-Fi around the office
items.why: Router = roteador: o aparelho que distribui o Wi-Fi.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ is fine today, so your video call will be clear."
items.why: Speed = velocidade da internet, importante para uma chamada de vídeo boa.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem quando você fala com o suporte de TI. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please log in with your password." To log in means to…
options: enter a system with your details
items.why: Log in = entrar no sistema com seus dados.

items.q: "Can you help me set up the Wi-Fi?" To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = preparar/configurar algo para usar.

items.q: "The internet is slow. Let's restart the router." To restart means to…
options: turn it off and on again
items.why: Restart = reiniciar: desligar e ligar de novo.

items.q: "If something looks strange, call IT support." This means to…
options: ask the IT team for help
items.why: Call IT support = pedir ajuda ao time de TI.

items.q: "The video is frozen. Let's join the meeting again." To join a meeting means to…
options: enter or connect to the meeting
items.why: Join a meeting = entrar/conectar-se à reunião online.
